verdict.rationale: Stable documents mail forwarding as a self-serve mailbox action ('Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included'), listed among the basic mail actions, so the core of forwarding without emailing support is present. Its 'auto-route' feature sends mail to internal teams and is not shipping-forward rules. missing for 10: rule-based or automatic forwarding, documented one-click forwarding flow, saved forwarding recipients/addresses, carrier choice, cost preview before confirming, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I can forward mail with rules or one click — saved recipients, carrier choice, and cost shown before I confirm — rather than emailing support

citations.quote: Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included.
Manage mail from anywhere with a digital mailbox — scan mail, forward packages, deposit checks, and more.
